details: Coinbase announced a deal on a crucial provision in a landmark crypto legislation, potentially clearing its path in the U.S. Senate. The agreement addresses earlier bank opposition to crypto firms offering yield-bearing products on stablecoins. This compromise aims to allow Americans to earn rewards on crypto platforms while introducing more regulatory oversight for stablecoins.
title: Coinbase Deal Advances US Crypto Bill

details: A Wall Street Journal investigation alleges that World Liberty Financial (WLF), a Trump-linked crypto venture, partnered with a virtual-currency company whose key figures were sanctioned by the U.S. Treasury for alleged ties to a transnational "pig butchering" scam network. The partnership, which enabled WLF's USD1 stablecoin, was announced less than a month after the sanctions. This development has led to a DOJ investigation into individuals central to WLF's operational strategy. Separately, the WLFI token associated with the venture has plummeted 7.85% amid a governance crisis and liquidity fears.
title: WSJ Links Trump Crypto Venture to Pig Butchering Scam

details: A Reuters investigation alleges that Nobitex, Iran's largest cryptocurrency exchange, has been used as a parallel financial system to bypass Western sanctions. The report claims the platform, founded by brothers from an influential family, processed funds tied to sanctioned Iranian institutions, including those associated with the central bank and the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC). Nobitex denies agreements with government agencies and states illicit use is a small fraction of activity.
title: Reuters: Iran's Nobitex Linked to Sanctions Evasion

details: The cryptocurrency market experienced $110 million in liquidations over the past 24 hours. Long positions accounted for $49.26 million, while short positions saw $61.22 million in liquidations. Bitcoin and Ethereum positions contributed significantly to these figures, with 99,559 traders liquidated globally.
title: Crypto Market Liquidates $110M in 24 Hours

details: Bitcoin's Spot Cumulative Volume Delta (CVD) has surged by 199%, indicating a strong re-acceleration of institutional inflows into the leading cryptocurrency. This suggests renewed buying pressure from institutional players, which could be a positive signal for market sentiment.
title: Institutional Bitcoin Inflows Re-Accelerate

details: U.S. Federal Reserve official Austan Goolsbee commented that last week's inflation data was concerning, emphasizing its negative implications for monetary policy. This hawkish sentiment from the Fed could impact market expectations for future interest rate decisions and broader risk appetite.
title: Fed Official 'Concerned' by Recent Inflation Data
